SCENE sc_001 0-143880 INT. ASHBURTON ESTATE CHAPEL – CONTINUOUS
EP46:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.
EP46:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.
EP46:E3 3500-5800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.
EP46:E4 5800-7100 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.
EP46:E5 7100-11000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.
EP46:E6 7800-11000 SOUND: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.
EP46:E7 11000-13800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.
EP46:E8 11500-16800 HIGH PRIEST [Booming, Authoritative]: "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
EP46:E9 13800-17200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
EP46:E10 15000-16800 SOUND: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
EP46:E11 17200-20500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.
EP46:E12 17300-20400 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Commanding]: "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
EP46:E13 20500-22800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.
EP46:E14 20600-22800 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory]: "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
EP46:E15 22800-26800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.
EP46:E16 22900-26500 HIGH PRIEST [Scornful, Harsh]: "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
EP46:E17 26800-30500 CAMERA: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.
EP46:E18 26800-31800 HIGH PRIEST [Resonant, Dismissive]: "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
EP46:E19 30500-34200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
EP46:E20 32500-34500 ACTION: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
EP46:E21 34200-37000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.
EP46:E22 34300-36700 ALEXANDER [Gravely, Firm]: "She married the man... not the title."
EP46:E23 37000-42800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.
EP46:E24 37300-42500 HIGH PRIEST [Harsh, Derisive]: "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."
EP46:E25 42800-47000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.
EP46:E26 42800-47000 HIGH PRIEST [Rigid, Formal]: "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."
EP46:E27 47000-49000 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.
EP46:E28 47100-49000 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Sharp]: "No licensed clergyman presided..."
EP46:E29 49000-52200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.
EP46:E30 49000-52200 HIGH PRIEST [Scathing]: "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."
EP46:E31 52200-58200 CAMERA: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.
EP46:E32 52200-58000 HIGH PRIEST [Thundering]: "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
EP46:E33 58200-62800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.
EP46:E34 58500-62500 JULIANA [Fierce, Defiant]: "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."
EP46:E35 62800-65800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
EP46:E36 62900-65500 JULIANA [Passionate, Resolute]: "I won't ask it for permission to love."
EP46:E37 65800-71000 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
EP46:E38 66800-70500 HIGH PRIEST [Condescending, Venomous]: "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."
EP46:E39 71000-76800 CAMERA: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
EP46:E40 71400-74300 JULIANA [Accusatory, Pained]: "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."
EP46:E41 74400-76600 JULIANA [Voice Breaking, Passionate]: "A church called me unworthy."
EP46:E42 76800-78000 CAMERA: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
EP46:E43 76800-78000 JULIANA [O.S.) (Bitter]: "A church chained me."
EP46:E44 78000-85800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
EP46:E45 78100-81000 JULIANA [Furious, Resolute]: "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
EP46:E46 81100-85500 JULIANA [Shouting, Triumphant]: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
EP46:E47 85800-89200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
EP46:E48 86100-89000 CATHERINE [Malicious, Taunting]: "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
EP46:E49 89200-92500 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
EP46:E50 89300-92400 HIGH PRIEST [O.S. / Low, Threatening]: "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
EP46:E51 92500-96000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
EP46:E52 92200-96200 HIGH PRIEST [Commanding, Severe]: "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
EP46:E53 96000-96800 CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
EP46:E54 96800-100500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
EP46:E55 96800-100400 HIGH PRIEST [Booming, Threatening]: "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
EP46:E56 100500-101800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
EP46:E57 101800-106800 CAMERA: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
EP46:E58 101800-106500 ALEXANDER [Cold, Resolute]: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
EP46:E59 106800-111800 CAMERA: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
EP46:E60 107000-111500 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Unflinching]: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
EP46:E61 111800-118500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
EP46:E62 112000-118200 ALEXANDER [Defiant, Commanding]: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
EP46:E63 118500-124000 CAMERA: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
EP46:E64 118800-123600 HIGH PRIEST [Chilling, Victorious]: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
EP46:E65 124000-126500 ALEXANDER [Steely, Unfazed]: "I'll take that wager over your decree."
EP46:E66 126500-127200 CAMERA: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
EP46:E67 127200-133500 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
EP46:E68 127200-133200 ALEXANDER [Thunderous, Imposing]: "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
EP46:E69 133500-138800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
EP46:E70 134000-136000 ACTION: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
EP46:E71 134200-138500 HIGH PRIEST [Ominous, Warning]: "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."
EP46:E72 138800-140500 CAMERA: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
EP46:E73 139000-142000 SOUND: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
EP46:E74 140500-143880 CAMERA: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.
EP46:E75 141200-143800 CATHERINE [Whispering, Malicious]: "Ten days is plenty of time."
